label: Priority f = g + h
subgoals: Track the cost so far g at each vertex
Add the Manhattan distance to the target as h
Order the open list by f = g + h

label: Which vertex is expanded next
subgoals: Compute f for every open vertex
Expand the vertex with the smallest f
Break ties toward larger g to reduce expansions

label: Admissibility and weighted A*
subgoals: Check that h never exceeds the true remaining cost
Check consistency edge by edge to avoid re-expansions
Divide a weighted-A* cost by w to bound the optimum
